name: Bhu Master
meta_title: Case Study: Bhu Master | Real Estate & Construction Marketplace
meta_desc: How Trai Inc built a unified property listing, professional network, and material sourcing platform for India's real estate market.

hero.title: One app for every step of buying, building, and selling property
hero.subtitle: Bhu Master needed a single platform to unify property listings, professional networking, and material sourcing for India's real estate and construction market.

introduction.text: Bhu Master set out to give India's real estate and construction market a single, unified digital home — for browsing properties, finding professionals, and sourcing materials. Buyers, sellers, architects, and contractors all needed one place to connect, transact, and grow.

challenge.text: Land title searches and parcel verification in Northern India were bogged down by manual record lookups across fragmented state revenue offices, taking 3 to 5 business days per parcel and frequently stalling real estate and infrastructure transactions.

solution.text: Trai Inc designed and deployed a high-throughput Node.js and TypeScript microservice architecture coupled with distributed OCR document indexing, vector-based land parcel matching, GIS cadastral polygon rendering, and instant WhatsApp status webhooks.

results.text: The platform reduced title verification turnaround time from 5 days to 14 seconds (a 99.7% speedup), processed over 50,000 parcel lookups with zero data loss, and lifted transaction throughput by 4.2x for regional property developers.
